# Issue

<!-- This template records results; it does not define additional requirements.
Process and gates: [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).
Skill quality requirements: [Skill standard](../skill-standard.md).
Keep entries proportional: short prose and evidence links are enough; combine related
fields and mark non-applicable details with a reason. Preserve identifiers, source
links, applicable checks, and audit evidence. Adjust links in the created artifact. -->

## Language

Write this issue in the operator's language.

## Issue ID

`issue-<YYYYMMDD>-<N>`

## Title

<!-- Short problem-focused title. -->

## Skill

<!-- Skill name and path relative to repository root. -->

## Context

<!-- What was being done, requested, or observed before the issue appeared? -->

## Problem

<!-- State the problem clearly. Include expected and actual behavior when applicable. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Link or cite source artifacts and raw evidence locators. Identify the observed snapshot, relevant input authority, and evidence limits; distinguish historical observations from current facts. -->

## Impact

<!-- Explain affected workflows, users, skill behavior, runtime behavior, or documentation quality. -->

## Scope

<!-- Define the current affected scope and exclusions, including the original failure path or protected invariant. -->

## Proposed Resolution

<!-- Describe the recommended fix or mitigation. -->

## Alternatives Considered

<!-- List relevant alternatives and why they were not chosen. -->

## Destructive Side Effects

<!-- Identify risks, compatibility concerns, data loss risks, workflow disruption, or migration impact. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe a check that could falsify the proposed fix and the claim it supports. Select applicable checks from the owning rules; document-only changes do not imply a runtime check. -->
